result.title: ALETHEIA: A Multi-Frequency Eddy Current Pulsed Thermography Dataset for Neural Operator Learning in Nondestructive Testing
result.summary: Learning neural solvers for spatiotemporal partial differential equations (PDEs) under real-world constraints remains a key challenge in scientific machine learning, especially for inverse tasks with sparse and noisy boundary observations. We present the Aletheia dataset, the first 3D benchmark for learning data-driven solvers in the context of nondestructive testing (NDT). The dataset simulates eddy-current-induced heating in conductive solids and models the resulting transient heat propagation governed by the heat equation. Aletheia contains over 4,700 high-resolution samples across 10 excitation frequencies (1-100,kHz), each providing volumetric heat source and temperature fields over time. It supports both forward prediction of temperature evolution and inverse reconstruction of internal heat sources or defects from surface infrared measurements. Real infrared thermography data from cracked rail specimens are included for calibration and comparison. We define four canonical tasks on both regular and irregular grids and benchmark them using various neural operators. Aletheia establishes a unified platform for evaluating neural PDE solvers under realistic NDT conditions, enabling progress in reliable, data-driven inverse modeling. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/sherlock-0327/ALETHEIA.

AI.brief_summary: 构建涡流脉冲热成像三维数据集（10 个激励频率、4700+ 样本），定义温度演化正向预测与由表面红外反演内部热源/缺陷的正逆任务，并用多种神经算子进行基准评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属科学机器学习中的 PDE 算子学习与无损检测数据集，未涉及多模态推理状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策；「稀疏表面观测反演内部状态」与 LVR 的类比过于宽泛，缺少可核查的具体方法线索。
